drivingQuestion: Is a statue holding excrement forbidden?

segments.he: בָּעֵי רַב אָשֵׁי: תָּפַשׂ בְּיָדוֹ צוֹאָה, מַהוּ? מִי אָמְרִינַן כּוּלֵּי עָלְמָא זִילוּ בְּאַפֵּיהּ כִּי צוֹאָה, אוֹ דִילְמָא הוּא מִיהוּ דְּזִיל בְּאַפֵּי כּוּלֵּי עָלְמָא כְּצוֹאָה? תֵּיקוּ.
segments.en: «Rav Ashi raises a dilemma:» If the idol «is grasping excrement in its hand, what is» the halakha? Is this meant to honor the statue, indicating that it is an object of idol worship? «Do we say» that the statue is forbidden, as this indicates that «the entire world is inferior to it like excrement, or perhaps» does this indicate that the idol itself «is inferior to the entire world like excrement?» The Gemara concludes: The question «shall stand» unresolved.
